name: Cascade only in discount (longs) / premium (shorts) of the last 5-bar swing range
why: so_cascade taken only when the entry is on the cheap side of the 50 % of the range between the last confirmed 5-minute swing high and low (n = 5): the institutional open flow is joined where the counter-party still has room to be wrong, not after the move has already used the range. Pre-registered 2026-10-18 (research/preregistered/2026-10-18_luxalgo_smc.md).
